result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_edge_attrs_by_id()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get attribute values for edges by edge ID. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L7626-L7692){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_edge_attrs_by_id(edge_attr, edges=None) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Similar to `get_edge_attrs()` but uses internal edge IDs instead of node pairs. Returns a dictionary keyed by integer edge IDs. Useful when working directly with edge ID references. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [edge_attr]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Attribute name to extract. [edges]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[int] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional list of edge IDs to query. If `None`, queries all edges. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [dict[int, any]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Dictionary mapping edge IDs to attribute values. Only includes edges that have the attribute set. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Let's create a simple graph and then get attributes by edge ID. ::: {#73ec63d3 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node("A") .add_node("B") .add_node("C") .add_edge("A", "B", weight=1.5, type="friend") .add_edge("B", "C", weight=2.0, type="colleague") ) ``` ::: Return dictionary for the first edge. ::: {#810dc41a .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} edge_ids = graph.get_edge_ids() graph.get_edge_attrs_by_id("weight", edges=edge_ids[:1]) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` {1: 1.5} ``` ::: ::: Get all edge types. ::: {#40bc2efd .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph.get_edge_attrs_by_id("type") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` {1: 'friend', 2: 'colleague'} ``` ::: :::
